description: §6.7.1a — the WILDCARD block arm `| _ e -> { … }` of an `!{}` inside an `on mount { }` body (behaviorally distinct from the `:>` recovery arm: a block arm runs side-effecting statements, produces no recovery value). `let r = risky() !{ | _ e -> { @status = "caught-wild" } }` — pre-fix bc51b610 fails E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC; post-fix the mount body routes through the real statement codegen and the wildcard arm's body runs at mount, writing @status. No input — the boot/mount shape.
rationale: §6.7.1a sugar-equivalence — a `!{}` wildcard block arm inside `on mount` lowers exactly as inside a `function` body. risky() fails; the `| _ e -> { … }` arm matches any error and runs its block, setting @status = "caught-wild".
